finding: Gboard showed a clipboard paste-suggestion chip (the current system clipboard item, which clearing Gboard clipboard history does not remove) above the SearchBar in 2 of 142 distinct phase G run 2 frames. The chip is absent from all UI XML, logs, receipts and the run stream (text search of every non-PNG file found no clipboard content).
detection: Coordinator visual inspection of all 142 distinct phase G run 2 frames via 18 contact sheets, then full-resolution crops of y 120-380 px for the two chip frames. All other frames, including every other SearchBar-focused frame (G01-*, G08-clear*, G08-keyboard-insets, G09-query*), show only the floating Gboard toolbar with no clipboard content.
originals: Unredacted originals were moved outside version control to the git-ignored /_backup_ns07_redaction/g-settings2/ folder (*.unredacted.png); they are never committed.
